ns2:section.sectionText: Graduate student enrollment section. Meets with LIS 490 STU. Location: Room 341 LIS Bldg, 501 E. Daniel St., C. See course syllabus (http://courseweb.lis.illinois.edu/~mwolske/lis490st/summer14/syllabusSummer14-LIS490ST.pdf) for details regarding specific studio project for Summer 2014 offering. Non-LIS graduuate students need Instructor permission to enroll (mwolske@illinois.edu / jongant@illinois.edu), but the expectation is prior experience with field of Community Informatics and/or Journalism demonstrated by successful completion of one of the following courses: LIS/INFO/MACS 202; LIS 418; LIS 451A4 or AL6; LIS 518; JOUR 415. 2 or 4 GR hours (be sure to enroll in your preferred credit amount)
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s).
